scope_policy.tool_mutations: tenant-scoped ToolMutation rows; no workspace/agent column
scope_policy.authority: require_role(UserRole.TEAM_LEAD) on both decision routes; service re-reads and conditionally claims the actor
scope_policy.tenant: get_current_tenant; target lookup is (mutation_id, tenant_id); foreign or missing target is 404

refused_prior_statuses.failed: 409 CONFLICT; a sandbox-failed mutation cannot be approved

routes.effect: conditional UPDATE of ToolMutation.sandbox_status to approved, plus one AuditLog receipt in the same transaction
conditional UPDATE of ToolMutation.sandbox_status to rejected, plus one AuditLog receipt in the same transaction

parallel_writer.guard: conditional UPDATE binds id, tenant, prior status, tool_name, mutated_code and execution_error; approved/rejected and all other non-pending/non-failed states are pre-checked and skipped without invoking the sandbox
parallel_writer.race_behavior: a reviewer or peer edit between the pre-check and the guarded UPDATE matches zero rows; the review decision is preserved and no passed/failed write is recorded

durable_ledger.operation_identity: AuditLog.id is the server-owned operation id autodev:tool-mutation:<supplied-or-generated>
durable_ledger.sensitive_material: no raw mutated code, execution-error text, SQL parameter, exception text, token or secret is stored or returned
durable_ledger.readback: fresh session on the same engine; audit fields and target status/material must match the original operation

result_states.verified: HTTP 200; target status and audit readback matched; effect=committed
result_states.already_applied: HTTP 200; same operation id and same material; one receipt/status write; replay=do_not_repeat
result_states.conflict: HTTP 409 typed ALREADY_REVIEWED / STALE_TARGET / OPERATION_CONFLICT; effect=none; refresh the record
result_states.not_applied: HTTP 409 confirmed local rollback; verification.effect=none; TOOL_MUTATION_TRANSACTION_ROLLED_BACK; target and audit absent
result_states.committed_unverified: HTTP 503; mutation committed but audit/target readback failed or was refuted; effect=committed; original identity; replay=do_not_repeat
result_states.effect_unknown: HTTP 503; commit confirmation lost; effect=unknown; original identity; replay=do_not_repeat; no exception SQL/parameters

consumers.list_candidates: TEAM_LEAD+/tenant list; decided items leave the selected status
consumers.check_auto_synthesis_readiness: counts passed only; approved/rejected are not counted
consumers.capability_gate: counts daily mutations, not review status; unchanged
consumers.skill_review_apply: accepted reviewed-improvement contract; untouched and included in regression
